Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned counsel for the opposite party alongwith learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

The present transfer application has been moved with prayer to transfer the Session Trial No.476 of 2023 (State vs. Salman and others) arising out of Case Crime No.177 of 2023, under Sections 498A,
304B, 506 I.P.C. and under Section 302 I.P.C. alongwith Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Modi Nagar, District Ghaziabad pending before the Additional Session Judge, Court No.15,
Ghaziabad from Ghaziabad to District Gautam Budh Nagar having competent jurisdiction or to some other district having competent jurisdiction.

sentences.text: It is submitted that in this case applicant is informant and resident of Bulandshahr.

He lodged an F.I.R. u/s 498A, 506, 304B I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act against the opposite parties in which after investigation charge sheet has been filed and is pending in the court of learned Additional Session Judge, Court No.15 at Ghaziabad.

entities.text: Additional Session Judge, Court No.15 at Ghaziabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Further submitted that the distance of Ghaziabad from Bulandshahr is 90 kms. and applicant is not feeling safe to come for evidence and become witness at Ghaziabad because opposite parties are threatening and pressurizing the applicant not to adduce the evidence, therefore, request to transfer the trial of the present case from Ghaziabad to District Gautam Budh Nagar or to some other District having equivalent jurisdiction.

Learned counsel for the respondent opposed the prayer as aforesaid and contended that in this case opposite party no.2 Salman is still in jail and opposite party nos.3 & 4 mother-in-law and father-in-law have only been released on bail.
There is no any threat or influence of the opposite parties to pressurize the informant or to the prosecution witnesses.
There is no any other ground to transfer the trial from Ghaziabad to Gautam Budh Nagar and no purpose will be served since both the districts are adjacent.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties as well as learned A.G.A., perusal of record, it appears that in this case trial is pending at Ghaziabad and request is made to transfer the trial from Ghaziabad to Gautam Budh Nagar.
The apprehension to the informant that the opposite parties will influence the prosecution witnesses has no any support.
There is no instance of making threat or influence the informant or any of the prosecution witnesses so far.
In case, there is any apprehension to the informant he may move before the learned trial court in this regard who will take necessary steps.
Accordingly, this transfer application is, hereby, rejected as having no sufficient ground to transfer the trial.
However, learned trial court is directed to take steps for the safety of the informant when he is summoned for the evidence.

Order Date :- 16.5.2024 Ashok Gupta  Sharif Shaifi vs State Of Up Through Secretary Home And 3 ... on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10206726/
